content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta version seems to have revealed several upcoming Apple home products, including a brand new HomePod mini, security cameras, the next-generation Siri Remote for use with the new Apple TV 4K, and the highly anticipated HomePad product.

After in-depth examination of the code, it also appears to provide several important clues about the HomePad's specifications...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that while the HomePad will most likely run a variant of tvOS, the operation may be more akin to a giant Apple Watch.

The code also revealed a rather interesting privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on widgets when it detects that your iPhone is nearby.

We expect the HomePad to launch in two versions: one with a base speaker, with a form factor similar to the HomePod; and another designed for wall-mounted installation.

Besides the other Apple home products I mentioned earlier, there are other unknown devices mentioned. I sincerely hope that includes a smart doorbell. Which Apple home product are you particularly looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
